Light rain falling around frogs and toads, creating a quiet nocturnal ambience.

ORTF Setup: 2 x CCM4 Schoeps Microphones in a Cinela windscreen

name: Light Rain, Frogs and Toads at Night - Rémire-Montjoly, French Guiana
